caption_L1: St. Vincent and the Grenadines : Infant mortality rate from 2009 to 2019 (in deaths per 1,000 live births) is a line chart. There is a linear scale from 2010 to 2018 along the x-axis, marked Year. Deaths per 1,000 live births is defined using a linear scale from 0 to 20 on the y-axis.
caption_L2L3: From the middle of 2009 to the middle of 2019 there was a steady linear decline in deaths from live births in St. Vincent and The Grenadines. In the middle of 2009 the rate of deaths per 1000 live births was between 15 and 20. By the middle of 2019 this had fallen to between 10 and 15.
